title: 2004 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: Handy Aaron helped a neighbor \(1 \frac{1}{4}\) hours on Monday, \(50\) minutes on Tuesday, from \(8:20\) to \(10:45\) on Wednesday morning, and a half-hour on Friday. He is paid \(\$3\) per hour. How much did he earn for the week?

solutions.text:
Aaron worked \(75\) minutes on Monday, \(50\) minutes on Tuesday, \(145\) minutes on Wednesday, and \(30\) minutes on Friday.

The total is \(75+50+145+30=300\) minutes, or \(5\) hours.

At \(\$3\) per hour, he earned \(5\cdot3=15\) dollars.

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Convert all the work times to minutes.
After finding total minutes, convert to hours before multiplying by \(\$3.\)
